title: Count insertion shifts
prompt: Implement `int insertionShifts(int[] arr)`: the total number of shifts insertion sort would perform on arr — for each element, the number of earlier elements greater than it. Pure trace arithmetic, no sorting needed: for each i, count j < i with arr[j] > arr[i].

tests.name: shift arithmetic
tests.hint: Sum over all pairs (j < i, arr[j] > arr[i]).
